Ubee: Is he Palestinian? Is he even an earthling? Last time we saw him he was wearing high-heels and rabbit ears, and for a sexually and artistically diverse organism we expect it, I think. Ubee is also one of the kindest and most generous people you will ever meet.
Ulrich: A silver-haired businessman who gives due where it's warranted, quickly disregarding those people and situations where it isn't. He can't help looking a little calous in his behaviours. One or some of his parents were German or Swiss, and what can you do?
Urijah:
Hard work - has he heard of it? Does he pick up after himself, even at 30 years of age? Having been blacklisted by many girls in the early days, we're hoping he's learnt a few lessons about civility and politeness. And he's great at spending other people's money 

(Note: If Urijah is rather shy then he is the exact opposite, and presents as a pinnacle of love and compassion.)
Usain: Hey? What are you saying?....Usain, you say?....Well, Christ, he's got to be happy, as in, happy all the time, right? And you can't be happy all the time without travelling plenty, yeah? And you can't be travelling plenty without occasionally being late for the airport, eh? So, here then, is the happiest man you'll meet, who's always heading as fast as he can towards somewhere, be it an airport, a girl's bedroom or the nearest ATM. Amen.
Ushun: Frizzy hair. Outstanding energy. He shadow boxes whenever he’s standing in any kind of queue.
Usman: Usman is a tranquil man who deals with pressure very well because he has very clear picture in his head of what he wants and where he is headed.
Uwe: Uwe, pronounced Oove, is a fascinating sticky beak who, like Rove and De Shan before him, is ostensibly unembarrasable. And yes, like Fergus and Laurina he's got some wonderful kinks.
